headline: Dragged Into Illegal GPU Re-export Issue, MGLV Management Speaks Out
summary: PT NexAI Digital Infrastruktur, listed as MGLV, denied allegations of illegal GPU re-export and said it is not involved in any illegal activity.
why: GPU re-export allegations involve export controls on advanced chips, which can create regulatory and reputational risk for companies in the AI infrastructure supply chain.
original_headline: Terseret Isu Reekspor GPU Ilegal, Manajemen MGLV Buka Suara
